evidence.example_de: Bei der Präsentation gab sie trotz ihrer Nervosität eine gute Figur ab.
evidence.example_fa: او با وجود اضطرابش در ارائه عملکرد و ظاهر خوبی داشت.

confirmed_findings.finding: The Persian rendering adds both performance and physical appearance. In this presentation context, eine gute Figur abgeben means making a good showing/impression; explicit physical appearance is unsupported.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Use natural Persian for making a good showing / appearing competent in the presentation, without adding a physical-appearance claim.

evidence.correct_examples: All four learner examples correctly use 'die Finger verbrennen'.

confirmed_findings.finding: The source contains a grammatical typo ('die Fingern'). The learner canonical layer copied it instead of recording a source repair. Standard German is 'sich die Finger verbrennen'.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Preserve exact source surface in provenance, add a source-repair ledger entry, and correct learner canonical/structure to 'sich die Finger verbrennen'.

evidence.definition_de: vor Verfolgung oder Gefahr auf der Flucht sein

confirmed_findings.finding: The definition repeats the target phrase itself and therefore does not independently explain the meaning; this is a residual circular-definition defect.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Replace with a non-circular definition such as 'vor Verfolgung oder Gefahr fliehen und noch nicht in Sicherheit sein'.

evidence.source_visual: PDF page 11 / printed page 9 visibly reads 'ein Flucht planen'

confirmed_findings.finding: The source has the wrong article for feminine Flucht ('ein Flucht'); the learner canonical layer copied the typo. Standard German is 'eine Flucht planen'.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Preserve verbatim source surface in provenance, record an explicit source repair, and correct learner canonical/structure to 'eine Flucht planen'.

examples_fa: یک کمک‌کننده به زندانی برای فرار کمک کرد.
چند نفر از اهالی روستا مخفیانه به افراد تحت تعقیب برای فرار کمک کردند.
راننده متهم شد که به مظنون برای فرار کمک کرده است.

confirmed_findings.finding: Several Persian examples calque the German valency as 'به ... برای فرار کمک کردن'; understandable but noticeably German-shaped.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Recast into natural Persian while preserving agent, beneficiary, tense and escape-assistance meaning.

evidence.example_de: Die Idee für ein gemeinsames Projekt nimmt konkrete Form an.
evidence.example_fa: ایدهٔ یک پروژهٔ مشترک دارد شکل مشخصی به خود می‌گیرد.

confirmed_findings.finding: The Persian progressive construction is clumsy and less natural than the German original.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Use a natural form such as 'ایدهٔ یک پروژهٔ مشترک کم‌کم شکل مشخصی به خود می‌گیرد'.

evidence.example_de: Wer in einem Menschen einen Freund hat, fühlt sich in schwierigen Zeiten weniger allein.
evidence.example_en: Anyone who has a friend in someone feels less alone in difficult times.

confirmed_findings.finding: The generic English phrase 'has a friend in someone' is formulaic and non-idiomatic in this sentence.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Use natural English such as 'Anyone who has a true friend by their side...' while preserving meaning.

confirmed_findings.finding: Stored source/canonical uses a comma after 'etw' although the PDF has the abbreviation period 'etw.'.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Correct the source occurrence transcription to 'etw. in Gang bringen / setzen' and align provenance/canonical/structure without changing identity.
